description: Single-DGX-Spark Qwen3.8 Flash Next on the TensorFold engine (exact decoding, custom CUDA kernels JIT-compiled on first start) with Vontra's MLX 4-bit checkpoint and MTP head, following taussoe's tensorfold-recipes (d8a7c09c, MIT). Runs taussoe's TensorFold fork (branch glm-long-context at c32abe92: TensorFold 0.3.6.3 plus agent-turn resume for Flash Next, so an agent's next turn resumes instead of re-reading its prompt; upstream measured a recorded 42-call agent session at 7.6 min instead of 16 with four parallel streams). Text only. Upstream measured on one Spark (0.3.6.3 plus agent turns): an automatic window of 157,607 tokens, decode 77 / 61 / 75 / 72 tok/s in the standard cells, a 32k prompt read at 2,102 tok/s and a 128k one at 1,840, and 181 tok/s together at 8 streams of 32k (upstream figures, unmeasured here). The 80.4 GB of weights plus 32 GB of n-gram tables held in the page cache are tight on one 128 GB Spark: run nothing else beside it (upstream advice), or choose the SSD-resident tables option. The model weights are under the Qwen Community License 1.0 (attribution above 100M MAU or US$20M monthly revenue; separate licence for Model-as-a-Service or AI Work Assistant businesses). Thinking is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: Open a think block by default (TensorFold default).
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next TensorFold single Spark (taussoe)
